## Report

Extracted all 9 assigned components, one export per file, into the fresh cart. Each is `export default function <Name>`. Imports follow the established pattern (`Icon` from `../../../runtime/icons/Icon`, `C`/`accentFor` from `../workspace.cls`, data from `../data/*`). Render bodies preserved verbatim from the mock, including MaterialFocusSurface's full color-studio UI and all dynamic inline styles.

`cart/editor/stage/`
- `Workspace.tsx` — props: `{ state: MockState; activeCommand: Command; activeAsset: Asset; onCommand; onTool; onSnap; onFloor; onViewMode; onStage; onContext; onObject; onExitMaterialFocus; onMaterialAction; onSelectColorStudioMaterial; onColorStudioVariant; onColorStudioSeed; onColorStudioQuality; onColorStudioSlot; onColorStudioFill; onColorStudioReset }`. Renders `<ToolOptions {...props}/>` + `<Stage {...props}/>`.
- `ToolOptions.tsx` — props: `{ state: MockState; activeCommand: Command; onCommand; onTool; onSnap; onFloor; onViewMode: (mode: ViewMode)=>void }`.
- `Stage.tsx` — props: `{ state: MockState; activeAsset: Asset; onCommand; onStage; onContext; onObject; onExitMaterialFocus; onMaterialAction; onSelectColorStudioMaterial; onColorStudioVariant; onColorStudioSeed; onColorStudioQuality; onColorStudioSlot; onColorStudioFill; onColorStudioReset }`. Imports siblings `MaterialFocusSurface`/`IsoMap`/`MiniMap` plus `ContextMenu`/`DropdownMenu` from `../shell/` (where another worker placed them).
- `MaterialFocusSurface.tsx` — props: `{ state: MockState; activeAsset: Asset; onExit; onAction; onSelectMaterial: (m: ColorStudioMaterialKey)=>void; onVariant; onSeed; onQuality; onSlot; onFill; onReset }`. Pulls SHADER_MATERIALS, resolvedSlotColor, bakedSlotRgb, materialPreviewCells, slotAssistColors, rgbToCss, rgbToVec3, colorStudioMaterial, colorStudioOverrideKey, QUALITY_LABELS, COLOR_LIBRARY_SETS from `../data/colorStudio`.
- `IsoMap.tsx` — props: `{ state: MockState; onObject: (id: string)=>void }`. Uses `assetById` from `../data/catalog`.
- `MiniMap.tsx` — props: `{ state: MockState; onObject: (id: string)=>void }`.

`cart/editor/inspector/`
- `Inspector.tsx` — props: `{ state: MockState; activeObject: WorldObject; activeAsset: Asset; onPane: (pane: string)=>void; onCommand; onPreset; onPresetOption: (preset: string)=>void }`. Renders `ReadOnlySection`, `PresetSection`, and `MissionSection` (the last is not mine).
- `ReadOnlySection.tsx` — props: `{ title: string; color: string; rows: string[][] }`. Only `C`/`accentFor` (no Icon/types needed).
- `PresetSection.tsx` — props: `{ title: string; color: string; active: string; options: string[]; open: boolean; rows: string[][]; onPreset: ()=>void; onOption: (preset: string)=>void }`.

No sub-components needed splitting out beyond the assigned list — every helper my parents render (ToolOptions/Stage for Workspace; MaterialFocusSurface/IsoMap/MiniMap for Stage; ReadOnlySection/PresetSection for Inspector) was already its own assigned file.

Verification: bundle-checked `MaterialFocusSurface`, `IsoMap`, `MiniMap`, `ToolOptions`, `ReadOnlySection`, `PresetSection`, plus the composites `Stage` and `Workspace` — all PASS via `tools/esbuild ... --bundle --format=esm --alias:@reactjit=runtime`. `Inspector` fails only on the not-yet-created `./MissionSection` (another worker's component); its path is wired correctly and will resolve once that file lands.
